Priya (PM): Heads-up: Atlas wants private deployment with strict data residency. Proposal: two-phase onboarding — Phase A (edge-only VPC peering + hosted fallback), Phase B (full on-prem gateway). Need owners and gating criteria.
Marco (Runtime): Two-phase makes sense. Phase A lets us validate traffic patterns against our hosted fallback. Need to know model peak seq len and if they require fp16 native.
Elena (Infra): For Phase B we need an on-prem connector + VPN termination + optional direct cross-connect. Network test window with their ops is required. Also region GPU quota note: us-central dedicated pool limited weeks 2166400000-2166500000.
Ravi (Security): Data residency: logs must stay in customer VPC. KMS options: cloud KMS (fast) vs customer-managed HSM (long lead). Audit retention preference? They asked for 1 year. That impacts storage and cost.
Jared (SRE): Staging plan: replicate production traffic for 48h, run failover and traffic-shift tests. Need an oncall post-GA for 2 weeks. Also want a chaos experiment (disk pressure + instance reboot).
Sophie (Product Ops): I'll own timeline and vendor ops. Suggested milestones: reqs & legal by 2171300000, Phase A staging by 2171450000, Phase A canary by 2171500000, Phase B start by 2171800000.
Noah (Legal): I'll try to get contract redlines within that window but need customer's SOC2/ISO paperwork. Ping me their compliance contact.
Priya (PM): Draft gating criteria (vote):
- Functional: model outputs match baseline eval on customer prompts (<=1.5% regression)
- Latency: p95 <= 150ms in Phase A (hosted fallback)
- Security: KMS/HSM choice agreed + threat model signoff
- Ops: runbook + incident contact + 2-week oncall scheduled
- Cost: clear committed capacity or burst reserve purchased

Marco (Runtime): Add memory/KV cache validation for 2048 token flows and GPU mem pressure tests. If quantization is needed, we must run quality evals on the quantized artifact.
Ravi (Security): Add requirement: E2E encryption for control plane endpoints and MFA for admin access. Also recommend a short internal pen-test before GA.
Elena (Infra): Note: their on-prem gateway uses an older NAT box that might not support our healthcheck pattern. We should add a small network probe script for their infra team to run.
Sophie (Product Ops): I'll create a customer-facing checklist we can share. Who will own the rollback thresholds?
Marco (Runtime): Runtime + SRE co-own rollback. Proposal: canary traffic at 10% for 24h, triggers: latency p95 > 250ms or error rate > 3% or token-quality regression > 2%. Rollback steps: 1) shift 100% to hosted fallback over 5 minutes, 2) scale up dedicated capacity if needed, 3) open SEV channel.
Jared (SRE): We'll automate the traffic shift and prepare runbook snippets for each step. Also will schedule chaos run during staging.
Priya (PM): Marco, can you post a minimal canary config? Put it in the PR.
Marco (Runtime): Sure, quick snippet:
```
canary:
  initial_percent: 10
  steady_hours: 24
  rollback_triggers:
    latency_p95_ms: 250
    error_rate_percent: 3
    quality_regression_percent: 2
  rollback_steps:
    - shift_to: redwood-hosted-fallback
      duration_minutes: 5
    - notify: oncall@redwood
```
I'll link model artifact QA checklist too.
Noah (Legal): Also flag export control / data transfer clauses for on-prem setups. I'll add a section in contract PR.
Ravi (Security): If they pick on-prem HSM we need 6 weeks. If cloud KMS, 3 weeks. Ask customer preference now.
Sophie (Product Ops): I'm adding owners: Marco (runtime checklist + canary), Elena (network + staging infra), Ravi (security signoff), Jared (runbook + chaos), Noah (contract), Priya (product owner).
Elena (Infra): One more: GPU flavor mismatch risk. Their on-prem GPUs are older Ampere v2; perf might differ. We'll need a perf parity run and possibly to recommend nearline inference as fallback.
Priya (PM): Good catch. Action items: Sophie share checklist with Atlas; Marco publish runtime/QA checklist; Elena schedule network probe call; Ravi confirm KMS timelines with customer; Noah start contract PR; Jared schedule staging + chaos. I'll open PR today with milestones.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment window opens in 2 weeks. Please confirm oncall with `@Jared`. :robot_face:
Jared (SRE): Confirmed. I'll reserve staging quota and block the calendar.
Priya (PM): Thanks all. We reconvene after PR is up — if customer prefers on-prem HSM we should revisit dates. :+1:
